printed.warm_start:
warm start: 300 epochs in 11.2 s · mean squared error 97.45 -> 0.2178 in log B
one field for all 4 wings cannot do better than 0.1115, which is how much the 4 belts differ from each other.
So the copy is essentially perfect — the eighteen Week 3 belts are the same shape scaled by
amplitude, and in log B that is a small shift against a range of fifteen. Which raises the
question Section 3 answers: if one field can copy them all, why would it need to know the wing?
